tukangkunci.title: Tukang Kunci Settings
tukangkunci.gui.click_to_remove: Click item to remove from filter
tukangkunci.gui.tooltip.enabled: Enable or disable the auto-opener mod entirely
tukangkunci.gui.tooltip.use_filter: Enable or disable filtering. If ON, vaults will only open if they contain items in the filter list.
tukangkunci.gui.tooltip.wind_burst: Only open vaults for Enchanted Books that have the Wind Burst enchantment
tukangkunci.gui.tooltip.auto_add_vault: When ON, the item inside a vault you look at will be automatically added to the filter list
tukangkunci.gui.tooltip.add_item: Add the entered item ID to the filter list
tukangkunci.gui.tooltip.clear_list: Remove all items from the filter list
tukangkunci.gui.tooltip.reset: Reset all settings to default values
tukangkunci.gui.tooltip.done: Save changes and return to the game
tukangkunci.gui.tooltip.filter_list: Items in this list will trigger vault auto-opening
